label: Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome: Successful Therapeutic Plasma Exchange Treatment After SARS-CoV-2 Infection-A Case Report.
summary: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a complex neuroimmunological disorder characterized by disabling symptoms that are often difficult to manage. More recently, in the context of SARS-CoV-2 infection, potential pathophysiological overlaps and disease modulation have been hypothesized. Our successful case highlights the need to investigate novel therapeutic approaches, including plasma exchange.
